integrity: All mathematical evidence consists of the written self-contained proof and the supplied standalone exact-integer checker. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The all-length theorem is binary and restricted to two-row lonesum matrices with at least two columns.
No analogous zero-free assertion is made for three or more rows or for nonbinary entries.
Full-text comparison is bounded; the possibility of a preexisting equivalent signed-matrix formula remains.
Finite exact computation corroborates the independent algebraic proof, and is not an infinite certificate.
title: Parity-complete Walsh spectrum of two-row lonesum matrices
